wiki.title: Robert Wittke
wiki.extract: Robert Otto Wittke Jr. (born September 23, 1957) is an American accountant and Republican politician from Racine County, Wisconsin. He is a member of the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Wisconsin's 63rd Assembly district since 2025; he previously represented the 62nd Assembly district from 2019 to 2025. Before his election to the Assembly, Wittke was president of the Racine Unified School Board for two years.
